spans.s:
mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Twentieth.
E.
विंशति twenty, and डट् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Twenty, collectively, or an aggregate of twenty.
E.
विंशति, and ड्वुन् aff.

always f. sing. (-तिः)
Twenty, a score.
du. (-ती)
Two twenties.
plu. (-तयः)
Many twenties.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Worth twenty, produced from or bought with twenty, &c.
E.
विंशति twenty, and कन् added.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Twentieth.
E.
विंशति, and तमट् aff.

m. (-शः)
A governor of twenty villages.
E.
विंशति, and ईश sovereign; also विंशतीशिन्.

m. (-शी)
Twenty, (collectively,) a score.
E.
विंशति, and डिन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bent, bowed, stooping.
2 Crooked, curved.
3 Humble, modest.
f. (-ता)
1 The wife of KAŚYAPA, and mother of ARUṆA and GARUḌ

A sort of basket.
E.
वि before नम to bow, aff. क्त.

m. (-नुः)
1 ARUṆA, the charioteer of the sun.
2 GARUḌA, the younger brother of ARUṆA.
E.
विनता the mother of these two, and सूनु the son.

f. (-तिः)
1 Bowing, bending.
2 Humility, modesty.
E.
वि before नम to bow, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-दः)
1 Sound, noise.
2 A tree, (Echites scholaris.)
E.
वि, नद to sound, अच् aff.

ind.
Having sounded, sounding.
E.
वि before नद to sound, ल्यप् aff.

n. (-नं)
Bending, bowing, bending down.
E.
वि before नम to bend, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bowed down, declined.
E.
वि, and नमित bowed.

mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं)
1 Bent, bowed.
2 Humble, modest.
E.
वि, and नम्र bowed.

m. (-यः)
1 Modesty, affability, humility, mildness.
2 Reverence, obeisance.
3 Decorum, decency, propriety, of conduct or behaviour.
4 Training, discipline.
f. (-या)
A plant, (Sida cordifolia, &c.)
E.
वि before णी to obtain or guide, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-हि-हिणी-हि)
Compliant, tractable, humble, governable.
E.
विनय humility, and ग्राहिन् who takes.

mfn. (-थी-थिनी-थि)
Behaving ill or improperly.
E.
विनय, and प्रमाथिन् vexing.

mfn. (-भा)
Modest, well-behaved.
E.
विनय, and भाज् who shares.

mfn. (-वाक्)
Speaking humbly or modestly.
f. (-वाक्)
Modest speech.
E.
विनय, and वाच् speech.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Compliant, tractable, governable.
E.
विनय humility, and स्थ who stays or is.

mfn. (-र्द्दन्-र्द्दन्ती-र्द्दत्)
Sounding, making a noise.
E.
वि, and नर्द्द to sound, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Destroying, destruction.
2 A country, northwest of Delhi, Kurukṣetra, the vicinity of the modern Paniput.
E.
वि before नश to destroy, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यती-श्यत्)
Perishing, decaying, perishable.
E.
वि before नश to perish, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Perishable.
E.
वि before नश to perish, क्वरप् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Lost, destroyed.
E.
वि, and नष्ट the same.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Disappearance, destruction.
E.
वि before नश to finish, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सी-सं)
Noseless.
E.
वि privative, and नस for नासिका the nose.

m. (-शः)
Disappearance, destruction, loss, annihilation.
E.
वि before नश to perish, aff. घञ्.

ind.
Without, except.
E.
वि privative, ना aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Judged, discussed.
2 Gained, obtained.
3 Fixed, placed.
4

Known.
5

Married, &c.
E.
विद to know, and aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Abandoned, left, relinquished.
E.
विना except, and कृत made.

f. (-का)
The 60th part of an Indian hour.
E.
वि, and नाडिका a Nārī, or hour of twenty-four minutes.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Deserted, unprotected, unowned.
E.
वि priv., नाथ a lord or master.

m. (-कः)
1 A Buddha, a Bauddha deified teacher.
2 GAṆ

EŚA.
3
GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆ

A Guru, or spiritual preceptor.
5 An obstacle, an impediment or difficulty.
f. (-यिका)
The wife of GARUḌA.
E.
वि before णी to conduct, to obtain, aff. खुल्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Destroying, a destroyer.
E.
वि before नश to perish, causal form, aff. वुञ्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Noseless.
E.
वि privative, नासिका the nose, or नासा with कप् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Destroying.
E.
वि before नश to perish, causal v., शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Destroyed.
E.
वि before नश to perish, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-शी-शिणी-शि)
1 Destroyer, destructive.
2 Perishing, being destroyed.
3 Undergoing change or transformation.
E.
वि before नश to perish, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
Ripe, mature.
E.
विनाश perishing, उन्मुख in the presence of; verging to rottenness.

m. (-हः)
The top or cover of a well.
E.
वि before नह to bind or tie, aff. घञ्; also वीनाह.

m. (-हः)
The top or cover of a well.
E.
वि before नह to bind, aff. घञ्; also विनाह.

n. (-णं)
Going forth or out.
E.
वि and निर्, before सू to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone forth or out.
E.
वि and निर्, before सृत gone.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Tossed, thrown, sent.
E.
वि and नि, before क्षिप्त thrown.

m. (-पः)
Tossing, throwing, sending.
E.
वि and नि, before क्षिप to throw, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-घ्नन्-घ्नती-घ्नत्)
Killing.
E.
वि before हन to kill, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
1 Blown, budded.
2 Awake, awakened, sleepless.
E.
वि privative, निद्रा sleep.

n. (-त्वं)
Vigilance, wakefulness, waking.
E.
विनिद्र sleepless, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, विनिद्रता.

ind.
Having taken or placed.
E.
वि, and नि before धा to have, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-तः)
1 Falling, falling down, (literally or figuratively, as from a height, or from dignity, virtue, &c.)
2 Calamity, unavoidable evil, the infliction of the gods or of fate.
3

Disrespect.
4

Pain, distress.
5 Death, destruction.
E.
वि and नि, prefixed to पत to fall, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Portentous, announcing misfortune or destruction.
E.
बिनिपात, and शंसिन् what proclaims.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Killed, destroyed.
2 Thrown down.
E.
वि, and नि before पत to fall, causal v., क्त aff.

ind.
Having killed.
E.
वि and नि, before पत to fall, causal v., ल्यप् aff.

m. (-यः)
1 Barter, exchange.
2 A pledge, a deposite or security.
E.
वि and नि, prefixed to मी to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Regulated, restrained.
E.
वि and नि, before यम to restrain, क्त aff.

m. (-मः)
Restraint, government.
E.
वि and नि, before यम to restrain, aff. अच्.

ind.
Having restrained, checked, &c.
E.
वि and नि, before यम to restrain, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Separated, sundered or detached from, absent, parted.
2 Appointed, attached to.
3 Parted with for a specific purpose.
4 Applied to, employed in.
E.
वि and नि, before युज to join, क्त aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be employed in, applied to, &c.
E.
वि and नि, before युज to join, तव्यर aff.

m. (-गः)
1 Giving or parting with any thing for a consideration, or in expectation of some advantage.
2 Abandoning, leaving.
3 Separation or detachment from.
4

Impediment.
5

Appointment to any office, &c.
6 Application to or employment in.
E.
वि and नि, before युज to join, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Appointed, appropriated, applied, (as to any particular duty or purpose, &c.)
2 Attached or joined to.
3 Deputed, appointed.
4 Employed.
E.
वि and नि, before युज to join, aff. क्त, with इट् augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone out or from.
E.
वि and निर्, before गम to go, क्त aff.

m. (-मः)
Going forth or out.
E.
वि and निर्, before गम to go, अच् aff.

m. (-यः)
Victory, conquest.
E.
वि and निर्, before जि to conquer, अच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Conquered, overcome.
E.
वि and निर्, before जि to conquer, क्त aff.

m. (-यः)
Certainty, ascertainment.
E.
वि, and निर्णय the same.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Certain, determined, ascertained.
E.
वि before निर्णीत the same.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Scattered, dissipated, dispersed.
E.
वि, and निर्द्धूत shaken.

ind.
Having dispersed, scattered, thrown off, &c.
E.
वि and निर्, before धू to agitate, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Liberated, let loose or free.
2 Exempt, free from.
E.
वि and निर् before मुच to loose, क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्य्यन्-र्य्यन्ती-र्य्यत्)
Going out or forth, issuing.
E.
वि and निर् before या to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
1 Excited, occasioned, produced, occurring.
2 Completed, finished.
E.
वि and निर् privative or intensitive prefixes, वृत to be, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Kept off, resisted, prevented.
2 Screened, covered, kept out of view.
E.
वि and नि before वॄ to chuse, क्त aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Stopped, ceased, ended, refrained, resting or desisting, &c.
E.
वि and नि privatives, वृत to be, aff. क्त.

f. (-त्तिः)
Stop, term, cessation.
E.
वि and नि before वृत to be, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-यः)
Certainty, ascertainment.
E.
वि, and निश्चय certainty.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Firm, steady, immovable.
E.
वि before निश्चल steady.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Certain, determined, ascertained.
E.
वि before निश्चित the same.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
1

Sighing.
2

Breathing hard.
E.
वि and नि before श्वस to breathe, शतृ aff.

m. (-सः)
Strong expiration, sighing, breathing hard.
E.
वि, and नि before श्वस to breathe, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Struck, wounded.
2 Overcome.
m. (-तः)
1 A portent, a comet, a meteor.
2 A great or unavoidable calamity; the infliction of fate or heaven.
E.
वि and नि intensitive prefixes, हत struck.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Hidden, concealed.
E.
वि, and निह्वुत the same.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Modest, humble, unassuming, unpretending.
2 Compliant, governable, tractable.
3 Placid, meek, virtuous, gentle, having the passions restrained, and the senses under subjection.
4 Well-behaved, decent, decorous.
5

Taken.
6

Trained, (as a horse or ox, &c.)
7 Thrown, sent, dismissed.
8 Lovely, handsome.
9 Led, conveyed.
10 Chastised, punished.
11 Plain, neat, (in dress, &c.)
m. (-तः)
1 A horse trained for the manege.
2 A merchant, a trader.
E.
वि before णी to guide, aff. क्त.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A mediate conveyance, as a bearer carrying a litter, or a horse dragging a carriage.
E.
वि implying sort or kind, and णी to take, aff. क्त, and कन् added.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
1 Well-behaved.
2 Humble, lowly.
E.
विनीत, and आत्मन् self.

ind.
Having taken.
m. (-यः)
1 Sediment, dregs.
2 Sin.
E.
वि before णी to take, aff. क्यप् or ल्यप्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being sent, ordered, dispatched, &c.
E.
वि before नुद to send, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-ता)
1 A guide, an instructor, a teacher.
2 A king, a ruler.
E.
वि before णी to conduct, aff. तृच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be taken, to be taken away or separated, &c.
2 To be governed or directed, docile, governable.
E.
वि before णी to take or obtain, &c., aff. यत्.

mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्)
Wishing or intending to take or take away, to deprive of, &c.
E.
वि before णी to take, शतृ aff. with a future sense.

f. (-क्तिः)
The rhetorical use of the word, ‘without;’ as, का निशाशशि ना विना What is the night without the moon.
E.
विना, and उक्ति saying.

m. (-दः)
1 Eagerness, vehemence.
2 Play, sport, pastime.
3 Dismissing, abandoning.
4 Interest, interesting pursuit or occupation.
5 Pleasure, gratification.
E.
वि before नुद to order, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dismissed, dissipated, sent or driven away.
2 Allayed, soothed.
3 Delighted, made happy.
E.
वि before नुद to send, क्त aff.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
Who or what finds, gets, gains, &c.
E.
विद to gain, श aff., नुन् augment.

mfn. (-न्दुः-न्दुः-न्दु)
1 Intelligent, knowing.
2 Liberal, munificent.
m. (-न्दुः)
1 A drop of water or any liquid.
2 A spot, a dot, a mark.
3 The bite or mark of a tooth.
4 The part of the forehead between the eye-brows.
5 A mark or spot of coloured paint on an elephant's face or trunk.
6 The dot over a letter representing the nasal termination.
7 A secondary but connecting incident in a drama.
E.
विद to know, to be, to be a part of, Uṇādi aff. उ, and the nasal augment.

m. (-कः)
The spotted deer.
E.
विन्दु a spot, and चित्रक variegated.

n. (-लं)
Coloured marks or spots on an elephant's face and trunk, &c.
E.
विन्दु a spot, and जाल multitude; also with कन् added, विन्दुजालक n. (-कं.)

m. (-न्त्रः)
A die, a dice.
E.
विन्दु a dot, and तन्त्र chief.

m. (-कः)
A kind of bird.
E.
विन्दु a spot, and रेखा a line, aff. कन्.

f. (-त्रः)
A plant, commonly Bel Saṇṭh.

m. (-न्ध्यः)
1 The Vindhya or Bindh mountain, or the mountainous range which runs across India from the province of Behar, nearly to Guzerat, and properly divides Hindustan from the

Dekhin.
2

A hunter.
f. (-न्ध्या)
1 A fruit, (Annona reticulata.).
2 Small cardamoms.
E.
वि implying opposition, ध्यै to think, and क aff., form irr.; the mountain is supposed to obstruct the course of the sun.

m. (-टः)
The saint AGASTYA.
E.
विन्ध्य the mountain, and कूट to give pain, aff. क, or with युच् aff. विन्ध्यकूटन; Vindhya the personified mountain, having once prostrated himself before AGASTYA his spiritual guide, was ordered by the saint to remain in that posture, as a punishment for the presumption, which had induced him to attempt rivalling the heighth of Meru and Himālaya. The legend appears to originate in the little elevation of the Vindhya chain compared with its extent.

m. (-सी)
The saint and grammarian VYĀḌI.
f. (-सिनी)
1 A name of

DURGĀ.
2

A village and temple sacred to DURGĀ under the forms of Yoga Māyā, and Bhoga Māyā, and a place of great resort amongst the Hindus, situated about three miles from Mirzāpur on the Ganges.
E.
विन्ध्य the mountain, and वासिन् who dwells.

m. (-स्थः)
The name of a Muni; also VYĀḌI, a saint, and inspired grammarian.
E.
विन्ध्य the mountain, and स्थ abiding.

m. (-लः)
The Vindhya range of mountains.
E.
विन्ध्य, and अचल a mountain; also विन्ध्यपर्ब्बत, विन्ध्यशैल.

f. (-वी)
The great Vindhya forest, which appears to have spread at one time from near Mathura to the Narmadā.
E.
विन्ध्य, and अटवी a forest.

m. (-त्त्रः)
A name of the demon BĀṆA or VĀṆA.
E.
विन्ध्यावली the mother of the demon, and पुत्त्र son; also विन्ध्यावलीसुत.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Placed, deposited, fixed.
2

Delivered.
3

Offered, presented.
E.
वि and नि before अस to be or throw, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Echites scholaris.)

m. (-सः)
1 Assemblage, collecting, collecting or depositing any thing.
2 Site, place, receptacle, that in or on which any thing is placed or deposited.
3 Orderly arrangement or disposition.
4 Entrusting, depositing.
5 A deposit.
E.
वि, and नि prefixed to अस to take, to throw or place, &c., aff. घञ्.
